description: Values mub6_haagerup.rs reads instead of computing them. None is evidence for any MUB(6) statement.

curvature_margin.reason: Margin epsilon - L*delta from the shared constants, used as every edge of the Haagerup 3-cycle cochain and as the Phi1 floor; it is not evaluated at the matrix H6. Feeds curvature_margin, phi1_circulation and the circulation fields of the Haagerup receipt (mub_target_a9_haagerup_receipt.json analogue).

h6_expected_imaginary_count.reason: Expected number of imaginary cross-ratios of H6, compared with the computed count and then reported as h6_imaginary_count in the Tao S6 isolation report. Not derived in the crate.

circulation_certified.reason: certified on the circulation certificate is written as true after checks whose inputs all come from curvature_margin, so it cannot come out false. Feeds the circulation fields of the Haagerup receipt.

receipt_verified.reason: verified on the Haagerup orbit receipt is written as true once the calls before it return Ok; it is not combined from their fields, and the circulation part rests on curvature_margin. Feeds verified in the receipt written by omega_mub_verify_all.
